verdict.rationale: The evidence documents Data Privacy Controls and Consent Filters that let mParticle customers honor GDPR consent and CCPA opt-outs for their own end-users' data. That is a related compliance feature, not a way for the mParticle user to opt out of the product's own telemetry or usage tracking. Nothing in the pack describes a setting to disable mParticle's telemetry on its users.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
